title: ROAM: Retrieval-Augmented Optimization for Feasible Multi-Day Itinerary Planning
title_zh: ROAM：面向可行性多日行程规划的检索增强优化方法

paragraphs.en: ROAM结合检索与时空优化，显著提升多日行程规划的可行性与路线效率。 Large language models (LLMs) can draft plausible travel itineraries, but the plans they produce are frequently infeasible: attractions are grouped into days without regard for geography, opening hours are ignored, and a single generation pass cannot reliably organize a multi-day trip. We present ROAM, a retrieval-augmented agentic framework for spontaneous multi-day itinerary planning that couples semantic preference retrieval with explicit spatiotemporal optimization. ROAM embeds the natural-language request, retrieves a compact candidate set from a curated point-of-interest (POI) database, partitions candidates into day groups through maximal-clique analysis and K-means, orders each day with a quality-biased simulated-annealing TSP solver, and repairs hard opening-hour violations with greedy exchange. A spatiotemporal retrieval layer injects weather forecasts, real road distances and POI operating hours into the prompt, after which the LLM renders a structured, map-ready itinerary; an interactive ReAct-style replanning agent then supports natural-language edits while re-checking feasibility. Across four Chinese cities and 510 POIs, ROAM produces 27.5 POIs per three-day plan versus 19.3 for a bare LLM and 17.0 for a retrieval-only baseline (+42% and +62%), while reducing route dispersion from 2,101 to 677 (3.1x). Ablations show that spatial optimization is the dominant driver of route efficiency and that hard time-window repair prevents roughly 30% of attractions from violating operating hours.
paragraphs.zh: ROAM结合检索与时空优化，显著提升多日行程规划的可行性与路线效率。大语言模型（LLM）能够起草看似合理的旅行行程，但其生成的计划常常不可行：景点被分到每一天时未考虑地理因素，开放时间被忽略，而且单次生成无法可靠地组织多日旅行。 我们提出ROAM，这是一个面向临时性多日行程规划的检索增强智能体框架，它将语义偏好检索与显式的时空优化相结合。 ROAM对自然语言请求进行嵌入，从一个经过整理的兴趣点（POI）数据库中检索出一个紧凑的候选集合，通过最大团分析与K-means将候选点划分为按天分组的集群，用带质量偏好的模拟退火TSP求解器对每天的路线进行排序，并用贪心交换来修复严重的开放时间冲突。 时空检索层将天气预报、真实道路距离和POI开放时间注入提示词，随后LLM渲染出结构化的、可直接在地图上呈现的行程；之后一个交互式的ReAct风格重规划智能体支持用自然语言进行修改，同时重新检查可行性。 在覆盖四个中国城市、510个POI的实验中，ROAM在三天行程中平均生成27.5个POI，而纯LLM为19.3个、仅检索的基线为17.0个（分别提升42%和62%），同时将路线离散度从2,101降至677（3.1倍）。 消融实验表明，空间优化是路线效率的主要驱动因素，而硬性时间窗修复可避免约30%的景点违反开放时间。
